title: Outstanding Yeasty Malaysian Prawns Toast
description: A delicious Malaysian dish featuring king prawns on yeasty toast, perfect for a special occasion, this halal-friendly recipe is sure to impress
instructions: In a large bowl, combine warm water and yeast, stirring to dissolve the yeast, then let it sit for 5 minutes
Add flour, salt, sugar, and yeast mixture to the bowl, mixing until a dough forms
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour
Punch down the dough and roll it out to a thickness of 1/2 inch
Cut the dough into 1 inch squares and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
Brush the tops of the dough squares with sesame oil and bake for 12 minutes, or until golden brown
While the toast is baking, heat butter in a skillet over medium heat and saute the king prawns until they are pink and cooked through
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and eggs, then pour the mixture over the cooked prawns and stir to combine
